description: Validation discovery while fixing zaq-5r5. Combined email/NotifyPerson/notifications/PeopleAuth/controller + people_browser suite seed 394634 fails deterministically at person_session_controller_test.exs:256: expected delivery_failed-specific flash, got generic request unavailable. Both combined runs passed all three browsers at 390/1280 and all receipt regressions. Controller location :227 alone passes; entire 21-test controller suite alone passes same seed. Suspect shared live rate budgets/config after browser tests (browser raises IP limit temporarily but real counters persist); root cause not yet proven. Preserve existing user changes; reproduce combined run with --include real_browser --timeout 180000. Independent of the one-field receipt output validation fix; no controller/runtime edits made.

comments.text: Root cause identified in fixture topology: controller HTTP requests reused default loopback peer while browser sends persist in Hammer ETS beyond SQL Sandbox rollback. Three browsers issue 18 sends; other request/resend cases can exhaust the default 20-IP budget before delivery-error assertions. Controller setup now assigns a per-Person unique trusted IPv6 peer, matching existing issuance isolation, preserving same IP for each request/resend scenario and all real transport assertions. Combined browser/controller seed validation remains to run.

Resolved and verified: browser-first/controller combined run at original seed 394634 passes 25 tests; final expanded 816-test + 23-property run also passes with all three browser engines before remaining controller scenarios. Existing delivery-specific flash and two transport expectations preserved.

title: [zaq-5r5] Isolate People controller delivery-error test from preceding browser rate budgets
